haiku.text:
Before any work I create the `feat/3814-cross-model-eval` branch off the default branch. I never commit to main and never push to main; changes reach it only through a reviewed PR.

```bash
git switch main
git pull --ff-only
git switch -c feat/3814-cross-model-eval
git commit -am "feat(eval): cross-model skill eval harness"
git push -u origin feat/3814-cross-model-eval
```
